symptoms.question: Do you hear clunking noises when driving over bumps? (yes/no)
Does the steering feel loose or vague? (yes/no)
Does the steering feel unusually heavy? (yes/no)
Does the car pull to one side when driving straight? (yes/no)

rules.diagnosis: Clunking over bumps can indicate worn suspension bushings, ball joints, or anti-roll bar links.
rules.advice: Drive carefully and book a suspension inspection soon to prevent worsening wear.

rules.diagnosis: Loose steering can be caused by worn steering components and can be a safety concern.
rules.advice: Reduce speed and have the steering checked as soon as possible.

rules.diagnosis: Heavy steering can indicate power steering issues, low fluid, or mechanical steering resistance.
rules.advice: Check power steering fluid if applicable and have the system inspected soon.

rules.diagnosis: Pulling to one side can be caused by alignment issues, tyre issues, or brake drag.
rules.advice: Check tyre pressures and book an alignment check. If pulling occurs mostly under braking, have brakes inspected.
